description: This file defines an abstract interface `Storage` for saving ZIP artifacts and a concrete implementation `LocalStorage` that saves files on the local filesystem within a temporary directory structure. It includes methods for saving ZIP data and generating storage paths, along with a factory function `get_storage()` that returns a storage instance based on configuration.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for storage implementations, requiring a `save_zip` method.

classes.name: LocalStorage
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the Storage interface that stores ZIP files on the local filesystem under a specified directory.
